description: This Java source file defines a utility class `EcuTableDefinitionHandler` used for parsing ECU (Engine Control Unit) definition XML files to extract specific table attributes and scaling information based on table name and node hierarchy. It contains static methods for XML DOM traversal and attribute extraction, focusing on retrieving data related to ECU tables within the XML structure.

classes.name: EcuTableDefinitionHandler
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for parsing ECU XML definition files to retrieve table attributes and scaling information based on table name and hierarchy.

methods.name: getTableDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a map of table and scaling attributes for a specified table name from a given XML Document and inheritance Node list.

methods.name: get2dTableMap
methods.description: Populates a map with attributes and scaling information for a specified table within a given Node.

methods.name: addAttributesAsMap
methods.description: Converts the attributes of an XML Node into key-value pairs within a provided map.
